verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Test of Spirit near her Tentacle walls and let the spirit expire; you win if you force fights away from walls where your Hemorrhage stacks and true-damage Guillotine outscale her sustain.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's entire power budget runs through Tentacles on nearby walls and the Vessel mechanic on her E (Test of Spirit) - away from a wall she has no healing engine and limited follow-up. Darius's stacking Hemorrhage bleed and true-damage Noxian Guillotine scale independently of her sustain, so this matchup is decided by where the fight happens, not by either kit being inherently stronger. That's why the head-to-head sits at an even 48.9% over 1120 games: it's a lane about forcing fights on your terms, not a stat check.

theirWindow.what: The spirit echoes a percentage of damage it takes back onto you, and if it dies or you get too far from it you become a Vessel that spawns Tentacles for her. Stand near the spirit and burst it down with Q/E rather than retreating.

yourWindow.when: She's away from any Tentacle wall
yourWindow.what: Without a wall to spawn Tentacles off, she has no sustain or follow-up damage source. Commit with Q's blade edge and E (Apprehend) to pull her into range and stack Hemorrhage before she can disengage.

start.why: Highest win-rate start (47.9% over 1195 games) and the sustain to out-trade her early poke before she has E online.

boots.why: Reduces the physical chip from her autos and Tentacle procs; the clear preferred pick at 76.8%.

core.why: Active haste closes the gap before she can retreat to a wall, and the burst passive adds to your Hemorrhage damage on the engage.
Stacking move speed keeps you attached through her W (Harsh Lesson) leap, and the HP/armor keeps you alive through Tentacle chip.
Converts her burst (W leap plus Tentacle procs) into damage over time so you survive the all-in and keep fighting long enough for the Guillotine execute.

situational.when: she itemizes to burst you down before your bleed stacks finish
tentacle procs and team physical poke are chipping you every fight
you need more slow uptime to stick before she reaches a wall

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking adaptive force and healing on extended trades matches a bleed-and-brawl matchup where she's also healing off Tentacles - Conqueror is the higher-sample, higher-win-rate pick (53%). Master-tier players instead run Stormraider's Surge (Sorcery) across 11,959 games for the extra movement speed to chase her down before she reaches a wall; take that version if you play a more aggressive, snowball-oriented style.

summoners.why: Flash+Ghost is the most-picked combo (59.2% pick) and the sustained movement speed is what actually lets you stick to Illaoi and force fights before she reaches a Tentacle wall. Flash+Ignite (35.2% pick) is the alternative if you want to guarantee an early-level kill before her sustain scales.

playing.title: Farm stacks behind minions
playing.detail: Land Q's blade edge and autos through your wave to build Hemorrhage stacks without walking into her Harsh Lesson or Tentacle range; this is OP.GG's own read on the matchup.

playing.title: Track wall proximity
playing.detail: Near a wall, her Q (Tentacle Smash) and W (Harsh Lesson) both hit harder and heal her through Tentacles. Fight in the center of the lane away from brush walls whenever you have the choice.

playing.title: Answer her E by killing the spirit
playing.detail: If she lands Test of Spirit on you, don't retreat - the target becomes a Vessel (spawning Tentacles for her) if the spirit dies or you get too far away. Stand near it and burst it down instead.

playing.title: Pull her with E (Apprehend) at range
playing.detail: Apprehend's passive makes your physical damage ignore a percentage of her armor on your target, and the active pulls her to you from 535 range - use it to force her into your melee burst before she can reposition near a Tentacle.

playing.title: All-in once Hemorrhage is near max
playing.detail: You enrage with massive bonus AD at 5 stacks of Hemorrhage. Chain Q-W-auto to stack bleed fast, then confirm the trade before her Tentacle sustain catches up.

playing.title: Hold R for the true-damage execute
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage scaled by her Hemorrhage stacks and refreshes its cooldown on a kill. At rank 1 it's on a 120s cooldown, so hold it until stacks are high rather than opening with it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, win rates, and pick rates above come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical reasoning on wall positioning, spirit-kill timing, and stack thresholds is my own read, not something OP.GG reports.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Illaoi’s (E) when fighting her. Try to get your passive stacks up by dealing damage while staying behind minions.
